newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ORIOLES LOSE HOILES WITH KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ORIOLES LOSE HOILES WITH KNEE INJURY.

text.p: The Baltimore Orioles on Wednesday placed starting catcher Chris Hoiles on the 15-day disabled list, retroactive to Tuesday, with a medial collateral sprain of the right knee.
Hoiles suffered the injury in Monday's 6-4 loss to Montreal when F.P. Santangelo slid into him at home.
Hoiles had broken out of a 2-for-27 slump with a solo homer in the fifth inning of that game, and is hitting .284 with eight homers and 30 RBI in 50 games this year.
He is in his ninth season with Baltimore (46-20), who have the best record in the major leagues.

Replacing Hoiles on the Orioles roster is catcher Tim Laker, whose contract was purchased from Triple-A Rochester. Laker, claimed off waivers from Montreal on March 25, was hitting .251 with eight homers and 26 RBI in 47 games with the Red Wings.
